info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Telecom Sim Esim Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Telecom SIM and eSIM Status API provides access to the current operational statuses of SIM and eSIM cards within the telecom system. This endpoint is primarily designed for developers and operators to monitor and manage the connectivity status of telecom resources. Use cases include diagnostic checks, reporting, and auditing of SIM and eSIM statuses used by service providers. By utilizing this API, businesses can ensure optimal performance and swift troubleshooting of their telecom offerings.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of the eSIM.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to obtain the current status of their eSIM, including activation status and any relevant error messages. It provides a quick way to check the operational state of the eSIM for troubleshooting or informational purposes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the current status of the eSIM. It may include filters or parameters that specify the type of status information desired.

200.description: The request was successful and the eSIM status is returned.

ListTelecomSimEsimStatusRequest.description: A string representing the status of the eSIM operations request.
